text: Everyone in that room was right... and everyone was wrong.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Rumi tells this story in the Masnavi.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: An elephant in a dark room. Nobody can see it... so they touch it.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: One felt its trunk... and declared that the beast resembled a water-pipe.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Another felt the ear... a large fan. The leg... a pillar. The back... a great throne.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: At work, a launch flops. Sales blames the price. Support... the bugs. Design... the look.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Each one holds a piece... and calls it the whole elephant.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Rumi says our senses work like the palm of a hand.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The whole of the object... is not grasped in the palm.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The twist? You're in that room too. Your piece always feels like the whole.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Before tonight, in one disagreement, ask... what are you seeing that I'm not?
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Which piece are you holding right now? Tell me below.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz... and see the whole elephant.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
